absent_reason: analysis_set: No held source explicitly identifies the analysis population for registry outcome 1 as ITT, mITT, per-protocol, safety, or all randomized; its POPULATION field is blank. Matching denominators do not establish ITT.

candidate_rejections.span: Over a median of 18.2 months, the primary outcome occurred in 386 of 2373 patients (16.3%) in the dapagliflozin group and in 502 of 2371 patients (21.2%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.74; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.65 to 0.85; P<0.001).
candidate_rejections.why: The primary composite includes urgent visits requiring intravenous therapy; it differs from the served composite of cardiovascular death or HF hospitalization.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Eligibility specifies adults with symptomatic HFrEF and LVEF ≤40%; ITT status is separately unverified.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Male or female, aged ≥18 years * Established documented diagnosis of symptomatic HFrEF (NYHA functional class II-IV), which has been present for at least 2 months * LVEF≤40%

notes: Registry spans are accepted because the held articles do not report the exact served secondary composite estimate. Served HR and counts match the registry. The served ITT label is unsupported. The requested estimand is RR, but the reported and served estimate is HR; no conversion was made.
